questions.question: In a certain code language, 'PIZZA' is coded as '336' and 'MANGO' is coded as '216'. How will 'BANANA' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
**The table is alphabets place value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is: 

**Sum of the positional values of the consonant alphabets and the positional values of the opposite alphabets of vowels × Total number of consonant in word = number.**

**PIZZA**** →** Total number of consonants (P, Z, Z) in the word is 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9780532da4ec9e551f254a4f44d8977c7763176672c203c469f58572bbbb7417.png] 

**Sum of the positional values of the consonant alphabets and the positional values of the opposite alphabets of vowels**** →**

16 + 18 + 26 + 26 + 26 = 112

Sum of the positional values of the letters of the opposite alphabet × Total number of consonants in word = number

112 × 3 = 336

And,

**MANGO**** →** Total number of consonants (M, N, G) in the word is 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8d1eef221a3f8c2ce0c74e134c7afc633760bd72cf88f6e0946542227ab42d1.png] 

**Sum of the positional values of the consonant alphabets and the positional values of the opposite alphabets of vowels**** →**

13 + 26 + 14 + 7 + 12 = 72

Sum of the positional values of the letters of the opposite alphabets × Total number of consonants in word = number

72 × 3 = 216

Similarly,

**BANANA** **→**** Total number of consonants (B, N, N) in the word is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/808968552d60bb6f40a92c61eb7ca7a463b0ae0e37af0eb97b59fe9952131f8f.png] 

**Sum of the positional values of the consonant alphabets and the positional values of the opposite alphabets of vowels**** →**

**2 + 26 + 14 + 26 + 14 + 26 = 108**

**Sum of the positional values of the letters of the opposite alphabet × Total number of consonants in word = number**

**108 × 3 = 324**

Hence, **BANANA** will be written as** “324”.**

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour hand and minute hand of a clock at 3:30 ?
questions.solution:

Hour hand covers 3600 in 12 hours

Angular distance covered in 1 hour = 360/12 = 300

Angular distance covered in 60 minutes = 300

Angular distance covered in 1 minutes = 1/20

__Calculation:__

Minute hand covers 360 in 60 minutes

60 minutes = 3600

1 minute =360/60 ⇒1 minute = 60

Here Given Time is 3 Hr 30 min

minute = 30

Angle covered by minute hand = 30 × 6 = 1800

Angle covered by hour hand = 3 × 30 + 30 × ½ = 90 + 15 = 105° 

Angle between hour and minute hands = 180 – 105 = 750

Hence, angle between hour and minute hands is 750

= 75°

Hence, the correct answer is 75°

questions.question: What is the integration between countries through foreign trade and foreign investments by multinational corporations (MNCs)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Globalisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Globalisation** refers to the process of integration and interaction among people, companies, and governments worldwide.
 
• It is driven by international trade and investment and is facilitated by information technology.
 
• Globalisation leads to the increased interdependence of economies, leading to more foreign trade and foreign investments by multinational corporations (MNCs).
 
• This process affects various aspects of economic, cultural, political, and environmental dimensions globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Trade**

 
 
• It refers to the exchange of goods and services between countries globally.
 
• World trade enables countries to obtain products they cannot produce or can obtain more cheaply from other countries.
 
• It is influenced by factors such as comparative advantage, trade policies, and international agreements.
 
 
 
• **International Trade**
 
 
• It specifically refers to the exchange of goods and services across international borders.
 
• International trade is a subset of world trade and involves exports and imports between countries.
 
• This trade is influenced by tariffs, trade agreements, and economic policies of the trading countries.
 
 
 
• **International Investment**
 
 
• It involves the allocation of capital by a company or individual in a foreign country.
 
• International investments can be in the form of foreign direct investment (FDI) or foreign portfolio investment (FPI).
 
• FDI involves direct control and management of the investment, while FPI involves passive holdings of foreign financial assets.

questions.question: Which one is the text not written by Abul Fazl?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Tabaqat-i-Akbari" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• Abu'l-Fazl ibn Mubarak, also known as Abul Sharma, Abu'l Fadl, and Abu'l-Fadl 'Allami, was the grand vizier of the Mughal emperor Akbar, from his appointment in 1579 until his death in 1602.
 
• The author of **"Tabaqat-i-Akbari"** was Khwaja Nizamuddin Ahmad. He was a Muslim historian of late medieval India.
 
• Akbar Nama, Ruqaʿāt, Inshā-i-Abu'l Fazl was written by Abul Fazl.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Akbarnama i**s a document of the history of Akbar's reign and his ancestors spread over three volumes. It contains the history of Akbar's ancestors from Timur to Humayun, Akbar's reign up to the 46th regnal year (1602), and an administrative report of Akbar's empire, the Ain-i-Akbari, which itself is in three volumes. 
 
• **The Ruqaʿāt** or the Ruqaʿāt-i-Abu'l Fazl is a collection of private letters from Abū al-Fażl to Murad, Akbar, Mariam Makani, Salim (Jahangir), Akbar's queens and daughters, his father, mother and brothers, and several other notable contemporaries.
 
• **The Inshā-i-Abul Fazl** or the Maqtubāt-i-Allami contains the official despatches written by Abu'l Fazl. It is divided into two parts.

Thus, the text not written by Abul Fazl is "Tabaqat-i-Akbari."

questions.question: A merchant offers a discount of 20% on the list price, due to which she makes a loss of 15%. What percentage profit or percentage loss will she make if she sells at a discount of 4% of the list price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Merchant offers a discount of 20% on the list price (LP), resulting in a loss of 15%.

We need to find the percentage profit or loss if she sells at a discount of 4% of the list price.

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = List Price (LP) - Discount

Discount = (Discount % / 100) × LP

Loss = Cost Price (CP) - Selling Price (SP)

Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100

Profit = Selling Price (SP) - Cost Price (CP)

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the List Price (LP) be ₹ 100.

**Scenario 1: 20% discount and 15% loss**

Discount = 20% of LP = 0.20 × 100 = ₹ 20

Selling Price (SP₁) = LP - Discount = 100 - 20 = ₹ 80

The merchant makes a loss of 15% on this sale. This means SP₁ is (100 - 15)% = 85% of the Cost Price (CP).

SP₁ = 85% of CP

80 = 0.85 × CP

CP = 80 / 0.85

CP = 80 / (85/100)

CP = (80 × 100) / 85

CP = 8000 / 85

CP = 1600 / 17 ≈ ₹ 94.1176

**Scenario 2: 4% discount on the list price**

New Discount = 4% of LP = 0.04 × 100 = ₹ 4

New Selling Price (SP₂) = LP - New Discount = 100 - 4 = ₹ 96

Now, compare SP₂ with the Cost Price (CP) calculated in Scenario 1.

CP = 1600 / 17

Since SP₂ (₹ 96) is greater than CP (₹ 1600/17 ≈ ₹ 94.1176), there will be a profit.

Profit = SP₂ - CP

= 96 - (1600 / 17)

= (96 × 17 - 1600) / 17

= (1632 - 1600) / 17

= 32 / 17

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

= [(32 / 17) / (1600 / 17)] × 100

= (32 / 1600) × 100

= (32 / 16) × 1 = 2%

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__

• **उड़ **का तत्सम शब्द **उड्ड** होता है।
 
• **ईख **का तत्सम शब्द **इक्षु **होता है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

• **तद्भव **का शाब्दिक अर्थ है – **उससे बने **(तत् + भव = उससे उत्पन्न), अर्थात **जो उससे** (संस्कृत से) उत्पन्न हुए हैं।
 
• यहाँ पर **तत् **शब्द भी** संस्कृत भाषा **की ओर इंगित करता है।

• **तत्** का अर्थ है – **उसके**, तथा **सम्** का अर्थ है –** समान।** अर्थात – ज्यों का त्यों। जिन शब्दों को **संस्कृत **से बिना किसी परिवर्तन के ले लिया जाता है, उन्हें **तत्सम शब्द **कहते हैं।
